svg.title: Agronomist — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as agronomist, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A crop’s leaves rise above a two-layer soil block while visible roots branch through the soil. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
